title: Understanding Grouping
text:
Factoring by grouping works when we can pair terms and find a common factor.

Group: $(2x^3 + 6x^2) + (3x + 9)$

Look for the HCF in each group separately.

title: Factor Each Group
text:
For the first group $(2x^3 + 6x^2)$:
- HCF of $2x^3$ and $6x^2$ is $2x^2$
- $2x^3 + 6x^2 = 2x^2(x + 3)$

For the second group $(3x + 9)$:
- HCF of $3x$ and $9$ is $3$
- $3x + 9 = 3(x + 3)$

title: Combined Result
text:
After factoring each group:

$2x^3 + 6x^2 + 3x + 9 = 2x^2(x + 3) + 3(x + 3)$

Notice that both terms now have $(x + 3)$ as a common factor!
